title: Too expensive for the size, good cheese cutting board.
text: Too expensive for the size, good cheese cutting board.. This is alright for cutting cheese maybe, it looks pretty and easy for everyday use, it is easy to clean and good quality but I am not sure why it's so small I was looking for a bigger one I guess I didn't notice the sizing but I was looking specifically for this when I bought it and it sells for the same price as the normal sized ones except it is small sized. In my opinion if you are looking for something to cut small pieces on or to display food on this is perfect but otherwise not for cutting a lot of things at once, maybe just cheese.
